exceptions.risk_acceptance: Development-only use accepts exactly the listed High findings under the Issue #150 OWNER authorization; this is not production approval or a claim that the findings are unreachable.
compensating_controls: Run only in the single-user mac-studio-solo Colima/k3s local lab without production data, credentials, or workloads.
Reconcile only repository-approved Git, OCI, and Helm sources; do not process untrusted archives or arbitrary third-party inputs.
Do not expose the lab through a public Service or Ingress.
Preserve immutable digest pinning, signature and transparency verification, SLSA provenance v1, SPDX/CycloneDX, and scan binding.
Rescan immediately if a digest, security advisory, or relevant evidence changes; expiry is fail-closed and automatic renewal is forbidden.
exceptions.replacement_plan: Migrate through a separately authorized review to the first signed upstream Flux distribution whose exact arm64 image has no unapproved High or Critical findings, then remove this exception.
